newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 10-yr EF note average accepted yield 7.69 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 10-yr EF note average accepted yield 7.69 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of the third issue of 10-year Exchange Fund Notes at Monday's tender was 7.69 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority said.
That compares with the average yield of 6.98 percent at the last 10-year auction in January and the average yield of 7.57 percent at the inaugural tender on October 28 last year.
The amount applied for the HK$500 million issue was HK$2.65 billion compared to HK$2.0 billion at the tender in January and HK$7.26 billion at the inaugural tender.
The 7.45-percent coupon notes will be issued on April 29, 1997, and mature on April 30, 2007.
